title: Sbitennik Drink Delivery
description: Sbitennik Drink Delivery — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Elmer Decembrist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Deliver a Sbitennik drink to Elmer the Decembrist in Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2 (off Level 5 of Ratsputin's Gulag).

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Elmer Decembrist

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Mors Drink Order

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Deliver a Sbitennik drink to Elmer the Decembrist in Ratsputin's Underground Network - Level 2 (off Level 5 of Ratsputin's Gulag).

Offer:

I need for you to run this juicy jar of Sbitennik to Elmer in Ratsputin's Underground Network. The poor sod is just standing around and acting like a town crier, hoping to change the world, but not receiving any change in his pocket for deeds done dirt cheap. Everyone knows change comes from within, anyway.

What is a Decembrist? Is that like one who thinks that one or two holidays in December isn't enough? I don't think that's enough to make me want to form a protest. In fact, I don't even want to bother wasting my beautiful mind thinking about protesting. I protest that there isn't any money being made right now and I have drinks to make.

Proceed into the bowels of Ratsputin's Gulag and find Elmer the Decembrist loitering in Ratsputin's Underground Network, which is located off of the fifth level of Ratsputin's Gulag. Deliver this hand-crafted labor of love.

Turn-in:

So at wast we finawwy meet, you pesky vawmint! Oh, my sincewe apowogies fow you not the cweatuwe that I thought you might have been, uh-hah-hah-hah. You awe the potion dewivewy pewson, awe you not? Weww, why don't we test viaw of goodness to see if Khodebshchik can wive up to theiw wawge cwaims. Oh, dat scwewy whiskerwing! Weww, I say new fwiend, this indeed is a scwumptious bevewage that I am pawtaking in, uh-hah-hah-hah. You can teww Khodebshchik that they don't have to wowwy about putting this money into theiw mouf and instead stwaight into theiw pocket. Good day to woo.

Objectives:

  • Sbitennik ×1

Client level range: 75–100
